items.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
items.summary: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability. https://opensre.com OpenSRE: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability Your CI tells you it broke, but not why or how to fix it. OpenSRE is a CLI agent that reads the failed run, traces the cause and pushes a fix for you to review. Self-hosted, with your own models. Quickstart · Docs · FAQ · Security 🚧 Public Alpha: Core workflows are usable for early exploration, though not yet fully stable. The project is in active development, and APIs and integrations may evolve. Before you begin Make sure you have: A terminal open in a code project A Git repository (recommended for the full workflow demonstration) Step 1: Install and start opensre macOS or Linux: curl -fsSL https://install.opensre.com | bash -s -- -gh Windows (PowerShell): & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://install.opensre.com/install.ps1))) -gh Then start OpenSRE: opensre Windows details: Windows. The installer fetches the latest build from main without requiring sudo. If opensre is not found, follow the PATH instructions printed by the installer or open a new terminal. For supported platforms and troubleshooting, see Install locally. Table of Contents Before you begin Install and start opensre Why OpenSRE? Quick Start Deployment How OpenSRE Works Integrations Security Telemetry License Citations Why OpenSRE? AI writes more of the code every month. Someone still has to fix the build. When CI goes red, it tells you that something failed, not why or how to fix it. Under deadline pressure, teams hit re-run and move on, flaky checks pile up, main stays red, and the real investigation waits for whichever senior engineer has time. OpenSRE is an open-source CI/CD reliability agent that does that investigation for you, built to run on your own infrastructure with your own models: Recover from red builds faster: it investigates the moment a run fails, reading logs, testing hypotheses and pushing a fix for you to review Fix the cause, not just the rerun: it separates CI-caused failures from code-caused ones, so you fix the right thing Know what CI is costing you: failure rate, developer hours lost to unreliable CI, and how long main stays red Senior-level context for everyone: every engineer gets the same depth of analysis SWE-bench1 showed that agents improve fastest with realistic tasks and clear feedback. Pipeline failures are slower, noisier and harder to reproduce than local code tasks, so we hold OpenSRE to the same standard by: running real-world end-to-end tests across cloud-backed scenarios (tests/e2e) keeping semantic test-catalog naming so e2e vs unit and local vs cloud boundaries stay obvious (tests/README.md) Start with the CI/CD overview: analyze a repository's CI reliability, fix failing checks on a PR, or set up an agent that keeps CI green. 1 https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.06770 Quick Start Contributors: start at main.py for the process entrypoint map. Run opensre to sign in and get started. The first launch activates the hosted model. opensre Webapp contributors can run opensre setup --dev to authenticate through http://localhost:3000. Interactive shell — with no subcommand, opensre validates your account and starts a REPL (TTY required). You can exit and stay signed out, but the shell only opens for an active account. Describe incidents in plain language, watch the agent work, and use slash commands for session control (/help, /status, /cost, /sessions, /resume, /compact, /new, /exit) and integrations (/integrations list, /integrations verify). Ctrl+C cancels an in-flight turn without losing session state. See interactive shell commands for the full reference. Headless CLI — run one agent turn non-interactively from a terminal, script, or CI job: opensre ask "why is checkout-api slow?" See Headless CLI for stdin prompts, JSON output, and tool approvals. From Python — drive the agent in-process from your own code (source checkout required): from surfaces.embedded import start_embedded_session session = start_embedded_session() result = session.chat("why is checkout-api slow?") # ``answered`` is true for any reply text, including a failed model call. # That failure sets accounting_status to "not_run" and stop_reason to "error". if result.action_result.accounting_status == "completed" and not result.cancelled: print(result.primary_response_text) See Python API for sessions, conversations, and custom output sinks. For your team's daily loop: embed OpenSRE in the Python services and automations your teammates already use. Start with the in-repo Python API guide, then use it every day to make incident response repeatable. Other useful commands: opensre integrations setup opensre update opensre uninstall # remove opensre and all local data Deployment An OpenSRE Cloud managed gateway, an AWS EC2 path, and a general self-hosted option: OpenSRE Cloud managed gateway: an organization admin provisions it in the web app; signed-in shell users can check, start, or stop it without handling infrastructure credentials locally. Gateway (AMI + systemd): make build-gateway-image then make deploy-gateway — Telegram gateway only, no Docker; the gateway is installed into a server image that new servers start from. Self-hosted container (Railway / ECS / Vercel): deploy the repo Dockerfile, select MODE, and set LLM_PROVIDER plus its API key. Use DATABASE_URL only when the gateway needs shared Postgres-backed state, such as Slack Events API replicas. Full deployment steps and prerequisites → DEPLOYMENT.md How OpenSRE Works When a CI run fails, an alert arrives, or you ask a question, OpenSRE automatically: Fetches the relevant context: failing checks and CI logs, recent commits and deploys, and correlated logs, metrics and traces Masks sensitive identifiers (optional) before external LLM calls Reasons across your connected systems to test hypotheses in a tool-calling loop, separating CI-caused failures from code-caused ones Answers with an evidence-linked response in the conversation Fixes the cause and pushes it to the PR branch for you to review, or suggests next steps and, optionally, executes remediation actions Posts a summary directly to Slack, PagerDuty, or Telegram — no context switching needed For the current code-level agent architecture after removing the old graph and chain framework layers, see AGENTS.md. Integrations OpenSRE connects to 60+ tools and services across the modern cloud stack, from LLM providers and observability platforms to infrastructure, databases, and incident management. Category Integrations Roadmap AI / LLM Providers Anthropic · OpenAI · OpenAI Codex · Ollama · Google Gemini · OpenRouter · TrustedRouter · NVIDIA NIM · Bedrock Observability Grafana (Loki · Mimir · Tempo · annotations) · Datadog · Honeycomb · Coralogix · groundcover · CloudWatch · Sentry · Elasticsearch · Better Stack · Splunk · Victoria Logs · SignOz · OpenObserve · OpenSearch · Azure Monitor · New Relic Infrastructure Kubernetes · AWS (S3 · Lambda · EKS · EC2 · CloudTrail · Bedrock) · Azure · ArgoCD · Helm Database MongoDB · ClickHouse · PostgreSQL · MySQL · MariaDB · MongoDB Atlas · Azure SQL · Snowflake · Redis · RDS · Supabase · Neon Data Platform Apache Airflow · Apache Kafka · Prefect · RabbitMQ · Dagster · Temporal Dev Tools GitHub · GitHub MCP · Bitbucket · GitLab · Jenkins Incident Management PagerDuty · Jira · Alertmanager · incident.io · ServiceNow · Trello (client helpers only) Linear Communication Slack · Google Docs · Discord · Telegram · Rocket.Chat · WhatsApp · Buzz Notion · Teams · Confluence Agent Deployment Vercel · EC2 · ECS · Railway Protocols MCP OpenSRE is community-built. Looking for a safe first contribution? Browse good first issue tickets or see the Good First Issues guide. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full workflow. Local environment: SETUP.md (all platforms, Windows, MCP). Developing in this repo: docs/DEVELOPMENT.md (install from source, CI parity checks, dev container, deployment detail, telemetry reference). Thanks goes to these amazing people: Security OpenSRE is designed with production environments in mind: structured and auditable LLM prompts, local transcript handling by default, and no silent bulk export of raw logs. See SECURITY.md for responsible disclosure. Telemetry First-party product analytics and Sentry (errors) are opt-out. Quick disable: export OPENSRE_NO_TELEMETRY=1 Full matrix, DSN override, and local event logging → docs/DEVELOPMENT.md License Apache 2.0 — see LICENSE. Citations 1 https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.06770

items.title: twentyhq/twenty
items.summary: The open alternative to Salesforce, designed for AI. https://twenty.com The #1 Open-Source CRM Website · Documentation · Roadmap · Discord · Figma Why Twenty Twenty gives technical teams the building blocks for a custom CRM that meets complex business needs and quickly adapts as the business evolves. Twenty is the CRM you build, ship, and version like the rest of your stack. Learn more about why we built Twenty Installation Cloud The fastest way to get started. Sign up at twenty.com and spin up a workspace in under a minute, with no infrastructure to manage and always up to date. Build an app Scaffold a new app with the Twenty CLI: npm install -g twenty twenty app init my-app cd my-app yarn install Define objects, fields, and views as code: import { defineObject, FieldType } from 'twenty-sdk/define'; export default defineObject({ nameSingular: 'deal', namePlural: 'deals', labelSingular: 'Deal', labelPlural: 'Deals', fields: [ { name: 'name', label: 'Name', type: FieldType.TEXT }, { name: 'amount', label: 'Amount', type: FieldType.CURRENCY }, { name: 'closeDate', label: 'Close Date', type: FieldType.DATE_TIME }, ], }); Then ship it to your workspace: twenty auth login --url https://your-workspace.twenty.com twenty app publish --private See the app development guide for objects, views, agents, and logic functions. Building with a coding agent? Install the official Twenty app skills, which work in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and any other harness supported by the skills CLI: npx skills add https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/tree/agent-skills --list The agent-skills branch is created by the first successful publish from main. Until then, use the local build instructions. SKILLS.md explains the other skill families in this repository and who they are for. Self-hosting Run Twenty on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, or contribute locally via the local setup guide. Everything you need Twenty gives you the building blocks of a modern CRM (objects, views, workflows, and agents) and lets you extend them as code. Here's a tour of what's in the box. items.title: visgl/deck.gl
items.summary: WebGL2 powered visualization framework https://deck.gl deck.gl | Website GPU-powered, highly performant large-scale data visualization deck.gl is designed to simplify high-performance, WebGL2/WebGPU based visualization of large data sets. Users can quickly get impressive visual results with minimal effort by composing existing layers, or leverage deck.gl's extensible architecture to address custom needs. deck.gl maps data (usually an array of JSON objects) into a stack of visual layers - e.g. icons, polygons, texts; and look at them with views: e.g. map, first-person, orthographic. deck.gl handles a number of challenges out of the box: Performant rendering and updating of large data sets Interactive event handling such as picking, highlighting and filtering Cartographic projections and integration with major basemap providers A catalog of proven, well-tested layers Deck.gl is designed to be highly customizable. All layers come with flexible APIs to allow programmatic control of each aspect of the rendering. All core classes such are easily extendable by the users to address custom use cases. Overview vLLM Ascend (vllm-ascend) is a community maintained hardware plugin for running vLLM seamlessly on the Huawei Ascend NPU. It is the recommended approach for supporting the Ascend backend within the vLLM community. It adheres to the principles outlined in the [RFC]: Hardware pluggable, providing a hardware-pluggable interface that decouples the integration of the Ascend NPU with vLLM. By using vLLM Ascend plugin, popular open-source models, including Transformer-like, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), Embedding, Multi-modal LLMs can run seamlessly on the Ascend NPU. items.title: wshobson/agents
items.summary: Plugins, agents, skills, and commands for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi, written once in Markdown and adapted to each tool by generators with validation and evals. https://sethhobson.com Plugins, agents, and skills for AI coding tools Use one collection of plugins, agents, skills, and commands across Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi. A harness is the coding tool that loads and runs the components. Contributors write each component once, in Markdown, in the Claude Code plugin format. Adapters under tools/adapters/ generate the format each harness reads, map model aliases to that harness's models, and translate tool permissions where the harness supports them. CI regenerates the artifacts for every harness, validates them, and runs the OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, and Pi artifacts through their installed CLIs. The capability matrix lists what each harness supports, and ARCHITECTURE.md describes the design. The catalog contains 93 plugins, including 91 local plugins and 2 external entries. The local source contains 199 agents, 185 skills, and 103 commands. Plugins cover Python and JavaScript development, code review, testing, infrastructure, security, and other work. Multi-harness support Choose the harness you use and follow its setup route. Available components depend on the installation route and the harness's capabilities. Tool Installation Components and limits Claude Code Plugin marketplace Source agents, skills, and commands; plugin-specific hooks and MCP configuration OpenAI Codex CLI Native marketplace or generated artifacts Native source skills; generated TOML agents and commands as skills use a separate route Cursor Plugin marketplace Source agents, skills, and commands, with curated project rules OpenCode make install-opencode Generated agents, skills, and commands, with translated tool permissions Antigravity CLI make install-antigravity Generated plugins containing agents, skills, and commands GitHub Copilot make install-copilot Generated agent profiles and skills; commands also become invocable skills Pi make install-pi Generated skills and prompt templates; agents require a subagent extension See the capability matrix for model mappings, tool permissions, hooks, and installation differences. For individual skills, use a skills-only installer and select your coding tool. How it works A plugin groups related agents, skills, and commands under plugins/. For example, python-development contains three agents, sixteen skills, and a scaffolding command. The chosen harness loads the installed components according to its own discovery and invocation rules. Contributors maintain one Markdown source in the Claude Code plugin format. Native registries point to that source where supported, and adapters generate the formats needed by each harness. Commands may become skills or prompt templates, and agent formats, model choices, and tool permissions vary by harness. Source agents specify model aliases such as opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, or inherit. Adapters map those aliases to each harness's model settings, including fixed defaults for some inherit entries. See model configuration and the adapter mappings. Quality evaluation The repository validates plugin structure, generated artifacts, and documentation. Contributors can run these checks from the repository root: make generate-all make validate STRICT=1 make garden plugin-eval also provides static skill checks without model calls. For example: uv run --project plugins/plugin-eval plugin-eval score plugins/python-development/skills/python-testing-patterns --depth quick The LLM judge and Monte Carlo layers are experimental and are not validated against human labels. Their scores describe model assessments and repeated simulations and do not prove that a task succeeds in a project. They require the optional llm dependencies. Model calls use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY when it is set and bill that API account. Otherwise they use your Claude Code login. See the evaluation guide for setup and limits. Quick start Choose a plugin for the work you do: Plugin Use it for python-development Python, Django, FastAPI, testing, and packaging javascript-typescript JavaScript and TypeScript development and project setup developer-essentials Code review, debugging, Git, and testing patterns security-scanning Security review, dependency checks, and code scanning See the plugin catalog for all 93 plugins and the usage guide for commands and examples. Claude Code Run these commands inside Claude Code to register the marketplace and install the Python development plugin: /plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents /plugin install python-development@claude-code-workflows Then ask Claude to use the Python agents for your task, or run the plugin's scaffolding command: /python-development:python-scaffold Create a FastAPI service with tests Codex CLI Run these commands in a terminal with a current Codex CLI: codex plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents codex plugin add python-development@claude-code-workflows The native Codex manifests expose source skills. The generated TOML agents and command-derived skills use a separate adapter path. Native installation also reads the original skill bodies, while generated copies split oversized bodies into reference files for the 8 KB budget. See the Codex setup details before choosing an installation route. Cursor Cursor uses the committed plugin marketplace registry. Follow the Cursor setup instructions to add the marketplace and install a plugin. Skills only Install an individual skill with GitHub CLI's gh skill command or the npx skills installer. Select your coding tool when prompted. Both installers read skills from GitHub without cloning the repository and install them without the plugin's agents, commands, or hooks. gh skill install wshobson/agents python-testing-patterns npx skills add wshobson/agents --skill python-testing-patterns gh skill requires GitHub CLI 2.90 or later. The npx command requires Node.js and npm. See skills-only installation for other agents, install scopes, and version pinning. Install from a clone For OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi, clone the repository and use the installer for your harness. Install uv, Python 3.12 or later, and the coding tool you want to use. The following clone command uses GitHub CLI: gh repo clone wshobson/agents ~/agents cd ~/agents Run the command for your tool. Each target generates the artifacts and links all local plugins into that tool's user configuration: make install-opencode make install-antigravity make install-copilot make install-pi Pi's agents require its reference subagent extension or a compatible extension. See the global install guide for configuration paths and uninstall commands. What's inside Component Count Purpose Plugins 93 Installable groups of components, including 91 local plugins and 2 external entries Agents 199 Instructions for specialist subagents that handle delegated work Skills 185 Guidance and reference material that an agent loads when relevant Commands 103 Named workflows you invoke, such as project scaffolding or a security scan The agent, skill, and command counts cover local source files. External plugins provide their own components and installation requirements. Documentation map Guide Covers Plugin catalog Plugins by task and domain Agents and skills Available components and model configuration Usage and tool setup Commands, examples, and installation Architecture and design details Source layout and adapters Quality evaluation and CLI verification Checks and their limits See CONTRIBUTING.md to propose a change and authoring conventions to write plugin content. External memory integration Pensyve remains an optional external Claude Code marketplace entry. Major7 Apps maintains Pensyve, and this repository's maintainer founded Major7 Apps. Its open-source runtime can run locally or on your own server. Pensyve Cloud closed on October 1, 2026, and its dashboard, API, and hosted MCP endpoints are unavailable. Use the self-hosting guide when configuring the runtime. License The repository is MIT licensed. External plugins have their own licenses. Star history

With rotating and static residential proxies, flexible geo-targeting, and HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 support, Swiftproxy is ideal for cross-region downloads, network testing, and browser automation. Free testing available, with 10% off using code PROXY90. The only downloader you need Documentation · Watch Video · Report Bug · Request Feature Features Fast where it matters. Every downloader is fast on a good connection. The real test is a bad one. Smart chunking without file merging. Auto-detects bandwidth. Real-browser TLS fingerprints, invisible to anti-bot checks. One app instead of five. Everything in one place, nothing watered down. HTTP, Magnet/BT, FTP, M3U8, MPEG-DASH, eD2k. YouTube and Bilibili with clip selection, any quality and subtitles, playlists and multi-part episodes. GitHub and HuggingFace with mirror acceleration. See it. Sniff it. Download it. Click it there, or just download as you normally would, the desktop app takes over seamlessly. No copying links, and authentication state carries over. Native on every platform. Key，示例在安装包内。之后用自己的访谈或播客，可选择竖版版式。没有字幕、本地 Whisper 装不上或太慢时，打开「设置 → 默认模型 → 语音转字幕」，改用百炼云端转写（qwen-audio-3.1-asr-flash，大约 0.1 元/小时音频，具体以阿里云账单为准）。音频会上传到云端。导入被拦住时，点「改用云端转写」。若安装本地转写，第一次要下载约 220 MB，国内网络约 15 分钟。 上若绑定目录出现权限错误，先修正数据目录的归属再启动： docker compose run --rm --no-deps --user root --entrypoint sh autoclip -c 'chown -R autoclip:autoclip /app/data /app/logs /app/uploads' docker compose up -d 从局域网 IP 或自定义域名打开时，在 .env 的 AUTOCLIP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS 填入前端地址（可逗号分隔）。 CLI / MCP 需要 Python 3.10+（建议 3.11），FFmpeg 与 FFprobe 在 PATH 中可用；本地 CLI 不需要 Redis。下载 正式 CLI / MCP ZIP，解压后在该目录执行： python3 -m venv venv source venv/bin/activate python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps autoclip_mcp-*-py3-none-any.whl 不下载 ZIP 时，可以直接一行安装。从源码安装仍可作为备选： # 一行安装 uvx autoclip-mcp
